svg.title: E1: both comparisons had to clear the margin
svg.desc: Mean improvement in absolute pressure error with 95 percent paired bootstrap intervals over 32 held-out episodes and 160 rows. Against the training constant the improvement is 0.00069 pascals, interval 0.00052 to 0.00086, which fails the useful margin of 0.00248 pascals. Against landmark persistence it is 0.0384 pascals, which passes. Because one comparison failed, the study result is null or inconclusive.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: E1: BOTH COMPARISONS HAD TO CLEAR THE MARGIN
32 held-out episodes, 160 rows, 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples
mean improvement in absolute pressure error (Pa); positive favours the model
frozen rule: both lower 95% endpoints above the margin; one failed, so the study result is null or inconclusive
